candidates.name: Privia Medical Group
candidates.description: Both provide platforms that enable independent primary care physicians to operate within a value-based care model.
candidates.rationale: Same value-based care enablement model for independent primary care practices and ACOs; highly comparable buyer base and service offering.

candidates.name: Vytalize
candidates.description: Both operate value-based care platforms specifically targeting independent primary care physicians and Medicare patients.
candidates.rationale: Same value-based care platform serving independent primary care practices and Medicare-focused ACOs; strong direct lookalike.

candidates.name: Agilon health
candidates.description: Both empower primary care physicians to transition to and deliver value-based care for senior populations.
candidates.rationale: Same value-based primary care enablement model for physician groups; closely overlapping buyer persona and customer base.

candidates.name: VillageMD
candidates.description: Both focus on the delivery of value-based primary care services nationwide.
candidates.rationale: Same value-based primary care/ACO enablement space, serving similar primary care customers and buyer personas.

candidates.name: Cano Health, LLC
candidates.description: Both provide primary and preventive healthcare services centered on a value-based reimbursement model.
candidates.rationale: Cano Health is a healthcare provider, not a value-based care enablement platform for practices and ACOs.

candidates.name: ChenMed LLC
candidates.description: Both specialize in personalized primary care for seniors with chronic diseases under value-based frameworks.
candidates.rationale: ChenMed is a primary care provider, not a value-based care enablement platform for independent practices and ACOs.

candidates.name: Oak Street Health, Inc.
candidates.description: Both operate primary care networks specifically designed for adults on Medicare.
candidates.rationale: Oak Street Health is a primary care provider network, not a value-based care enablement platform like Aledade.

candidates.name: Somatus, Inc.
candidates.description: Both utilize value-based care models to manage specific patient populations for health plans and providers.
candidates.rationale: Same value-based care enablement space; both sell to health plans and providers supporting managed patient populations.

candidates.name: Astrana Health, Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide the technological and operational infrastructure to support providers in delivering quality, value-based care.
candidates.rationale: Same value-based care enablement space for providers; comparable customer base and platform model.

candidates.name: Equality Health, LLC
candidates.description: Both provide value-based care platforms for independent practices, with Equality Health focusing on Medicaid patients.
candidates.rationale: Same value-based care platform model for independent practices/ACOs; overlapping buyer and use case, despite Medicaid emphasis.
